evidence: Reviewed criterion-to-requirement mapping for both gates and every Functional/Polish/Visual criterion; no confirmed unrequired demand. Public instruction.md:1,5,13,15 supplies working authenticated shared storage, named screens, craft/accessibility, recovery, saved theme and accounts. hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 and the actual public seed supply roster fidelity, exact arithmetic, creation IDs, role/tier matrix, budget, revisions, grants/payments/referrals, history, clocks, atomicity and visible figures. In particular rules:84-89 explicitly requires safe-integer exact monetary inputs/results, supporting the large valid UI amounts in functional/judge.toml:191; rules:310-316 supplies date-only/full UTC and millisecond boundaries. Rules:380-386 expressly requires ignoring the named optional claims and HTTP401/403, so the claims and status demands at functional/judge.toml:605-677 are public, not golden-only API assumptions. Rules:397-400 explicitly requires actor and before/after receipts readable after restart; instruction.md:13 requires input retention and loading/empty/failure states. A conforming alternative with arbitrary routes, field names, generated revision IDs, stacked/scrollable compensation detail, native controls, omitted zero financial rows and semantic date/money formats remains accepted: functional/prompt.md:11, functional/judge.toml:137,398 and the individual zero-value criteria explicitly permit these choices; Polish also permits nonmodal forms and native keyboard behavior. Broken-app challenge: a no-op HTTP200 creation shell is correctly excluded by the constraints gate because fresh independent readback is required; a dead approval implementation may satisfy this minimal gate but receives its approval/lifecycle deductions separately, matching the public required outcomes. Existing local/gate-witness/results.json observed exactly those distinctions (golden true, dead_approval basic gate true, no_op_create false). Verified its SHA256 fd8410bc91102874ef98edfdbacf19f7853687956e076acc684d36c565d9ec75 and all entry matching_source_files hashes against this frozen candidate. These are supplementary scripted observations, not a configured judge run or portal score. The Pass is limited to this row's semantic fairness; no full runtime clearance is asserted.
